name: Hive 1.10.4
notes: Fixes the default-view behavior added in 1.10.3: switching workspaces now reliably lands you on that workspace's most-recent chat (so People, Agents & tools, Review and the other panels populate) instead of intermittently not sticking. Includes 1.10.3's workspace improvements — remembered folder, and Code/Diff reachable without opening a chat.
